visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a heavy, floor-to-ceiling beige pleated curtain within an indoor dressing room. The curtain hangs from a white rail, and a hand appears from the left to grasp the fabric edge. The lighting is bright and even across the neutral-colored surface, revealing a patterned tiled floor at the base. (2) A young woman with long, straight dark hair emerges from behind the curtain, wearing a coordinated denim outfit consisting of a bandeau-style crop top and a pleated mini skirt, both featuring multiple brown leather-style belts. She performs a series of dance moves and poses, including arm flourishes and hair flips, while facing the camera. Behind her, a white wall displays the text 'NIIN Boutique', and to the right is a tall mirror reflecting the room's white walls and another curtain. (3) As she attempts a more energetic dance move, her heels slip on the white patterned tiled floor, causing her to lose balance and fall backward. The camera quickly tilts downward to track her descent. She lands on the floor and transitions to a crawling position on all fours, looking up at the lens with a self-conscious smile while her hair hangs forward, and a garment steamer becomes visible in the background corner.
